newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse falls in mixed trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse falls in mixed trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index dipped slightly on Wednesday, dragged down by Aluworks ALW.GH which fell 33 cedis to 1,300 cedis and Ghana Commercial Bank which declined 9 cedis to 619.
The Ghana All-Share index edged 0.58 points down to 362.82 from 363.40 on Monday.
Among the main risers were Unilever (+10 to 810), Accra Brewery Limited (+5 to 605) and Pioneer Tobacco Limited (+5 to 155).
A total of 39,620 shares changed hands compared to a thin 11,950 on Monday. Bids continued to outpace offers by 560,120 to 3,931,300.
